Kenyon Office of Institutional Research (IR) CMS\n\nA CMS for Kenyon College's Office of Institutional Research: a two-person office\n(Director + Analyst/intern staff) that publishes survey results, data briefs,\nand durable reference documents like the Factbook and Common Data Set.\n\n## Language\n\n**Director**:\nThe admin role. Modeled on the real office's Associate VP for Institutional\nResearch — the only person who can publish or edit a Report, manage user\naccounts, and deactivate access.\n_Avoid_: Admin, superuser\n\n**Analyst**:\nThe editor role. Each intern gets their own named Analyst account (see\nADR-003). Can draft and publish Data Bites directly; can draft but not\npublish or edit Reports. Any Analyst may edit any other Analyst's draft\n(shift continuity), though the original author is preserved.\n_Avoid_: Editor, intern (interns are Analysts, not a separate role), staff\n\n**Data Bite**:\nA Post: a short, dated item — a survey result, an enrollment snapshot, an\nannouncement. The frequent, low-stakes content type. Analysts can publish\nthese without Director approval.\n_Avoid_: Update, post, announcement, article\n\n**Report**:\nA Page: a durable, cite-able reference document — the Factbook, a Common Data\nSet, the Survey Coordination Policy. Appears in public navigation. Only the\nDirector can publish or edit a Report, even one an Analyst drafted.\n_Avoid_: Page, document\n\n**Draft**:\nContent (a Data Bite or Report) that has been saved but not published. Never\nappears on the public site. Used for unreleased data, e.g. enrollment numbers\nstill being verified before the official count.\n_Avoid_: Unpublished, pending\n\n**Published**:\nContent visible on the public site. The one-way gate: a Report only crosses\nit with Director action.\n_Avoid_: Live, public\n\n**Chart image**:\nAn *uploaded* PNG, JPEG, or WebP picture (usually a chart made in Excel, R,\nor Tableau) that a Data Bite or Report shows inline, placed in its body with\nthe Editor's \"Insert image\", with a required description, and stored there as\n`image:<name>` (T18). It belongs to its item and is published with\nit (ADR-004). Not a **Chart**, which the CMS draws from data, and not a\nReport's **attached file**, which is a PDF offered for download.\n_Avoid_: figure, graphic, media, attachment\n\n**Chart**:\nA bar, horizontal bar, or line chart the CMS *draws* from data typed or\npasted into it, shown inline in a Data Bite or Report body with its data\navailable as a table (spec #14,\n[ADR-006](docs/adr/ADR-006-charts-drawn-from-data.md)). Stored in the body\nas a `chart` block the writer never sees. Not a **Chart image**, which is made elsewhere and uploaded.\n_Avoid_: graph, plot, visualization\n\n**Chart builder**:\nThe Editor's \"Insert chart\" dialog: a Chart's fields and a grid (categories\ndown, series across) that takes typing or a paste from Excel or Sheets, with\nthe Chart drawn by the server as the writer types and each error beside its\nfield or cell (spec #14, T17). In the body, a Chart shows as a *card*, its\ndrawing with Edit and Remove.\n_Avoid_: chart editor, chart wizard\n\n**Editor**:\nThe visual body editor on a Data Bite's or Report's edit page: a toolbar,\ntables edited in place, Charts, and Chart images, with no Markdown in sight.\nThe body is still stored as Markdown (spec #14,\n[ADR-005](docs/adr/ADR-005-editor-stores-markdown.md)). A part of a body it\ncan't represent is a **locked block**: shown read-only, kept byte for byte.\n_Avoid_: WYSIWYG, rich text, rich-text editor\n\n**Site link**:\nA link in a Data Bite's or Report's body to another Data Bite or Report,\npicked from a list in the Editor and stored by the target's immutable\nreference, its *site reference* (`report:<ref>`, `data-bite:<ref>`), never\nits title, slug, or id.\nIt is a link on the site only while its target is Published; otherwise it\nshows as plain text (spec #14, T14).\n_Avoid_: internal link, cross-reference\n\n**Site preview**:\nA Draft (or unsaved edits) rendered as its public page would look, with the\nsite's nav and stylesheet and a \"Draft preview, not published\" banner. Saves\nnothing and publishes nothing.\n_Avoid_: live view\n\n**Summary**:\nOne or two sentences of plain text about a Data Bite or Report, at most 200\ncharacters, written under its title on the edit form. Shown under the title\non its page, in the lists and the Reports table, and in its page's\ndescription and link-preview tags (spec #22, T20). Optional: an item without\none shows nothing in its place.\n_Avoid_: excerpt, abstract, description, blurb\n\n**Homepage settings**:\nThe homepage's headline, its accent (the end of the headline, in bright\npurple), its intro, and its Key figures. Edited by the Director only, at\n/admin/homepage. Settings, not content: no Draft, and on the public site from\nthe next `cms publish`, like a change to the nav (spec #22, T20).\n_Avoid_: hero, homepage content\n\n**Key figure**:\nOne of up to four numbers on the homepage, each a value, a label saying what\nit counts, and an optional note saying when or of whom (e.g. \"1,805\" /\n\"Students enrolled\" / \"Fall 2026 census\"). Typed text, not drawn from data.\n_Avoid_: stat, KPI, metric\n\n**Site search**:\nThe public site's search of published titles and Summaries, entirely static:\n`cms publish` writes `search-index.json` and `search.html`, and\n`search.js` searches the index in the browser. Without JavaScript,\n`search.html` lists every published item. Bodies are not searched (spec #22,\nT20).\n_Avoid_: search engine, full-text search\n\n**Confirmation**:\nThe one-line message the admin console shows, once, after a save, publish,\nupload, delete, or user change succeeds (`app/flash.py`). Fixed text only:\nnever a title, email, filename, or password. A refused action gets an error,\nnot a Confirmation.\n_Avoid_: flash, toast, notification, success message\n\n**Factbook**:\nA specific Report: the office's running reference document of admissions,\nenrollment, diversity, and academic program statistics.\n\n**Common Data Set (CDS)**:\nA specific Report: a standardized annual institutional data submission,\npublished publicly.\n\n**Survey Calendar**:\nA specific Report: the schedule of past, current, and upcoming surveys the\noffice runs (e.g. faculty/staff surveys, external review surveys).\n-----\ndocs:\nadr\nagents\ndesign\nhandoff\nmanual_iphs400_mp2-web-cms_20260922.md\nmp2-grading-rubric_20260922.md\nmp2-setup_context-threshold-hook_20260922.md\nprocess\nscreenshots\ntranscripts\n\ndocs/adr:\nADR-001-local-admin-static-public.md\nADR-002-stack.md\nADR-003-split-publish-rights.md\nADR-004-chart-images.md\nADR-005-editor-stores-markdown.md\nADR-006-charts-drawn-from-data.md\nADR-007-public-site-stylesheet-and-fonts.md\n\ndocs/agents:\ndomain.md\nissue-tracker.md\n\ndocs/design:\nadmin-console-mockup\nsession-22-mockup\n\ndocs/design/admin-console-mockup:\nconsole.css\ndata-bites.html\nedit.html\nindex.html\nscreenshots\n\ndocs/design/admin-console-mockup/screenshots:\ndashboard-1440-768-390-dark.jpg\ndashboard-1440-768-390-light.jpg\ndata-bites-1440-768-390-light.jpg\nedit-1440-768-390-dark.jpg\nedit-1440-768-390-light.jpg\n-----\n.claude/hooks/ctx_compact_log.py\n.claude/hooks/ctx_guard.py\n.claude/hooks/ctx_statusline.py\n.claude/hooks/save_transcript.py\n.claude/settings.json\n.claude/skills/PINNED.md\n.env.example\n.gitignore\nCLAUDE.md\nCONTEXT.md\nREADME.md\nSECURITY-CHECKLIST.md\napp/__init__.py\napp/auth.py\napp/chart_drawing.py\napp/chart_images.py\napp/charts.py\napp/cli.py\napp/content.py\napp/data_bites.py\napp/db.py\napp/editor.py\napp/flash.py\napp/homepage.py\napp/main.py\napp/markdown_form.py\napp/public_site.py\napp/publish.py\napp/rendering.py\napp/reports.py\napp/routes/__init__.py\napp/routes/admin.py\napp/routes/auth.py\napp/routes/charts.py\napp/routes/data_bites.py\napp/routes/editing.py\napp/routes/homepage.py\napp/routes/public.py\napp/routes/reports.py\napp/routes/site_preview.py\napp/routes/users.py\napp/settings.py\napp/site_links.py\napp/templating.py\napp/uploads.py\napp/users.py\ndocs/adr/ADR-001-local-admin-static-public.md\ndocs/adr/ADR-002-stack.md\ndocs/adr/ADR-003-split-publish-rights.md\ndocs/adr/ADR-004-chart-images.md\ndocs/adr/ADR-005-editor-stores-markdown.md\ndocs/adr/ADR-006-charts-drawn-from-data ADR-007: The public site's own stylesheet, self-hosted fonts, and 404.html\n\n**Status:** accepted (spec #22, ticket #23)\n**Date:** 2026-10-01\n\n## Context\n\nBefore spec #22, the public site and the admin console shared one stylesheet:\na Python string, `app.public_site.CSS`, served at `style.css` and written\nthere by `cms publish`. The public site's rules and every `.admin-*` rule\nwere in it, so each side's styles reached the other's pages. Spec #22 gives\nthe public site a real design (\"set like a dataset\") with its own typefaces,\nand leaves the console's look as it is until a later spec.\n\nThe site is served from a GitHub Pages subfolder with relative paths only\n(ADR-001), and `pyproject.toml` is fixed (ADR-002).\n\n## Decision\n\n- **Two stylesheets, as files.** `static/site.css` is the public site's. The\n  app serves it at `style.css`, the Site preview serves it from its own copy\n  of the site, and `cms publish` copies it to `site/style.css`. All three read\n  the file through `app.public_site.assets()`. `static/admin.css` is the\n  console's: the old rules unchanged, minus the Site preview banner, served at\n  `/admin.css` (outside the login, so the login page has it). It is never\n  exported. `public/layout.html` is a standalone layout and `base.html` stays\n  the console's, so neither links the other's stylesheet. Tests check both\n  directions.\n- **Self-hosted fonts.** Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (roman and italic) and\n  Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, as variable `.woff2` files in `static/fonts/`.\n  Each font's SIL Open Font License is committed beside it. They are served\n  and exported at `fonts/` beside the stylesheet, which loads them by relative\n  `url()`s, together with the licences. The footer links the licences, so they\n  travel with the fonts and the crawler reaches them. There is no CDN: a font\n  host would be a second origin and a request for every visitor.\n- **404.html carries a `<base>`.** GitHub Pages serves `404.html` at whatever\n  missing URL was asked for, at any depth, so a relative link in it resolves\n  against the wrong folder. With `CMS_BASE_PATH` set to the deployed site's\n  full URL (given a trailing `/` if it lacks one), `404.html` has\n  `<base href=\"CMS_BASE_PATH\">`, and its links work at any depth. A value\n  that isn't an `http(s)://` URL is ignored, since a path alone would be a\n  root-absolute link. With it\n  unset (local use), it inlines its stylesheet and links as from the site's\n  root, which is right for a miss at the top level. Fonts then load only for\n  a top-level miss.\n- **The crawler's one exception.** The T07/T08 crawler, which fails on any\n  root-absolute or absolute site link, allows exactly one `<base>`, in\n  `404.html`. The crawler starts from `index.html` and `404.html`, and follows\n  the stylesheet's `url()`s.\n- **The skip link under a `<base>`.** `#main` resolves against a `<base>`,\n  not the page. `404.html`'s `<base>` is the site's root, so its skip link is\n  `404.html#main`: the same page, at its own path. A Site preview, a\n  sandboxed frame in the console, has no skip link.\n- **Chart series, by count, the newest last.** One series is Kenyon purple;\n  two are bright purple then Kenyon purple, as spec #22 says. A third and\n  fourth series are greys (`#8A849B`, then `#5D5870` in light and `#E4E0EE`\n  in dark), not more bright purple, so no two series share a colour. Citron\n  stays off Charts: it is the field's accent only. In dark mode, Kenyon\n  purple `#4B2E84` is 1.8:1 on the dark paper, so the newest series takes\n  the dark theme's Kenyon purple step, the light `#A99CFF`, and bright purple\n  a deeper `#6352D6` (3.4:1) to stay apart from it. The colours come from\n  `:has()` on the figure; without it every series is Kenyon purple.\n\n## Consequences\n\n- A designer can change the public site's CSS without touching Python, and\n  without risk to the console's styles.\n- The console still looks like it did before spec #22. Its own redesign is a\n  later spec, and it will start from `static/admin.css`.\n- A font update is a file swap. The licence files have to be kept with the\n  fonts.\n## Why this is an ADR\n\nIt changes how every page gets its styles and where the site's files come\nfrom, and the `<base>` in `404.html` is the one exception to ADR-001's\nrelative-links rule. That is surprising without the reason.\n# Domain Docs\n\nHow the engineering skills should consume this repo's domain documentation when exploring the codebase.\n\n## Before exploring, read these\n\n- **`CONTEXT.md`** at the repo root, or\n- **`CONTEXT-MAP.md`** at the repo root if it exists: it points at one `CONTEXT.md` per context. Read each one relevant to the topic.\n- **`docs/adr/`**: read ADRs that touch the area you're about to work in. In multi-context repos, also check `src/<context>/docs/adr/` for context-scoped decisions.\n\nIf any of these files don't exist, **proceed silently**. Don't flag their absence; don't suggest creating them upfront. The `/domain-modeling` skill (reached via `/grill-with-docs` and `/improve-codebase-architecture`) creates them lazily when terms or decisions actually get resolved.\n\n## File structure\n\nSingle-context repo (most repos):\n\n```\n/\n├── CONTEXT.md\n├── docs/adr/\n│   ├── 0001-event-sourced-orders.md\n│   └── 0002-postgres-for-write-model.md\n└── src/\n```\n\nMulti-context repo (presence of `CONTEXT-MAP.md` at the root):\n\n```\n/\n├── CONTEXT-MAP.md\n├── docs/adr/                          ← system-wide decisions\n└── src/\n    ├── ordering/\n    │   ├── CONTEXT.md\n    │   └── docs/adr/                  ← context-specific decisions\n    └── billing/\n        ├── CONTEXT.md\n        └── docs/adr/\n```\n\n## Use the glossary's vocabulary\n\nWhen your output names a domain concept (in an issue title, a refactor proposal, a hypothesis, a test name), use the term as defined in `CONTEXT.md`. Don't drift to synonyms the glossary explicitly avoids.\n\nIf the concept you need isn't in the glossary yet, that's a signal: either you're inventing language the project doesn't use (reconsider) or there's a real gap (note it for `/domain-modeling`).\n\n## Flag ADR conflicts\n\nIf your output contradicts an existing ADR, surface it explicitly rather than silently overriding:\n\n> _Contradicts ADR-0007 (event-sourced orders), but worth reopening because…_\n# Issue tracker: GitHub\n\nIssues and specs for this repo live as GitHub issues. --json number,title,body,labels,comments --jq '[.[] | {number, title, body, labels: [.labels[].name], comments: [.comments[].body]}]'` with appropriate `--label` and `--state` The `/domain-modeling` skill (reached via `/grill-with-docs` and `/improve-codebase-architecture`) creates them lazily when terms or decisions actually get resolved.\n\n## File structure\n\nSingle-context repo (most repos):\n\n```\n/\n├── CONTEXT.md\n├── docs/adr/\n│   ├── 0001-event-sourced-orders.md\n│   └── 0002-postgres-for-write-model.md\n└── src/\n```\n\nMulti-context repo (presence of `CONTEXT-MAP.md` at the root):\n\n```\n/\n├── CONTEXT-MAP.md\n├── docs/adr/                          ← system-wide decisions\n└── src/\n    ├── ordering/\n    │   ├── CONTEXT.md\n    │   └── docs/adr/                  ← context-specific decisions\n    └── billing/\n        ├── CONTEXT.md\n        └── docs/adr/\n```\n\n## Use the glossary's vocabulary\n\nWhen your output names a domain concept (in an issue title, a refactor proposal, a hypothesis, a test name), use the term as defined in `CONTEXT.md`. Don't drift to synonyms the glossary explicitly avoids.\n\nIf the concept you need isn't in the glossary yet, that's a signal: either you're inventing language the project doesn't use (reconsider) or there's a real gap (note it for `/domain-modeling`).\n\n## Flag ADR conflicts\n\nIf your output contradicts an existing ADR, surface it explicitly rather than silently overriding:\n\n> _Contradicts ADR-0007 (event-sourced orders), but worth reopening because…_\n# Issue tracker: GitHub\n\nIssues and specs for this repo live as GitHub issues. Use the `gh` CLI for all operations.\n\n## Conventions\n\n- **Create an issue**: `gh issue create --title \"...\" --body \"...\"`. templates/base.html\n<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"en\">\n<head>\n  <meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n  <meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\">\n  {%- block head %}{% endblock %}\n  <title>{% block title %}{{ title }}{% endblock %}</title>\n  <link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"{{ path_for('admin_stylesheet') }}\">\n</head>\n<body>\n  {%- block banner %}{% endblock %}\n  <header><a class=\"header-home\" href=\"{{ home_path | default('index.html') }}\">{{ title }}</a>{% block nav %}{% endblock %}</header>\n  <main>\n    {%- if user is defined and user %}{% set message = confirmation() %}\n    {%- if message %}<p class=\"admin-confirmation\" role=\"status\">{{ message }}</p>{% endif %}{% endif %}\n    {%- block content %}{% endblock %}</main>\n  <footer><small>IPHS 400 Mini-Project #2</small></footer>\n</body>\n</html>\n##### templates/login.html\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>Log in</h1>\n  {% if error %}<p role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"/login\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p><label>Email <input type=\"email\" name=\"email\" required autocomplete=\"username\"></label></p>\n    <p><label>Password <input type=\"password\" name=\"password\" required autocomplete=\"current-password\"></label></p>\n    <p><button type=\"submit\">Log in</button></p>\n  </form>\n{% endblock %}\n##### templates/admin/forbidden.html\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>Not allowed</h1>\n  <p role=\"alert\">{{ reason }}</p>\n  <p><a href=\"{{ path_for('admin_home') }}\">Back to the dashboard</a></p>\n{% endblock %}\n##### templates/admin/confirm_delete.html\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <p><a href=\"{{ back }}\">All {{ noun }}s</a></p>\n  <h1>Delete {{ noun }}</h1>\n  <p>Delete <strong>{{ item.title }}</strong>? This can't be undone.</p>\n  {% if linked_from %}\n  <p>These link to it. Once it is deleted, each of those links shows as plain text:</p>\n  <ul class=\"admin-linked-from\">\n    {% for found in linked_from %}\n    <li>{{ found.noun }}: <a href=\"{{ path_for('edit_bite_form', bite_id=found.id) if found.kind == 'data-bite' else path_for('edit_report_form', report_id=found.id) }}\">{{ found.title }}</a></li>\n    {% endfor %}\n  </ul>\n  {% else %}\n  <p>No other Report or Data Bite links to it.</p>\n  {% endif %}\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ action }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <button type=\"submit\">Delete {{ noun }}</button>\n    <a href=\"{{ back }}\">Cancel</a>\n  </form>\n{% endblock %}\n##### templates/admin/users.html\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>Users</h1>\n  {% if error %}<p role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n  <table>\n    <thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Email</th><th>Role</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead>\n    <tbody>\n    {% for u in users %}\n      <tr id=\"user-{{ u.id }}\">\n        <td>{{ u.name }}{% if u.id == user.id %} (you){% endif %}</td>\n        <td>{{ u.email }}</td>\n        {# No controls on your own row (you can't demote or deactivate yourself)\n           or on a deactivated one. #}\n        {% if u.id == user.id or not u.is_active %}\n        <td>{{ u.role | role_label }}</td>\n        <td>{{ \"Active\" if u.is_active else \"Deactivated\" }}</td>\n        {% else %}\n        <td>\n          <form method=\"post\" action=\"/admin/users/{{ u.id }}/role\">\n            <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n            <select name=\"role\" aria-label=\"Role for {{ u.email }}\">\n              {% for value, label in role_labels.items() %}\n                <option value=\"{{ value }}\"{% if value == u.role %} selected{% endif %}>{{ label }}</option>\n              {% endfor %}\n            </select>\n its own.\nEvery public page shares one layout: numbered nav, a title field, ISO dates,\nand a 404.html that works at any depth once CMS_BASE_PATH is set.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import public_site, settings\nfrom app.publish import render_site\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import BITE, create_bite\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import REPORT\nfrom tests.test_t05_report_files import pdf, post_with_file\nfrom tests.test_t07_public_site import nav, published_bite, published_report\nfrom tests.test_t08_publish import exported\nfrom tests.test_t12_site_preview import preview\n\nFONTS = sorted(path.name for path in (settings.STATIC / \"fonts\").glob(\"*.woff2\"))\nPUBLIC_PAGES = [\"/\", \"/data-bites/index.html\", \"/data-bites/fall-enrollment.html\",\n                \"/reports/index.html\", \"/reports/factbook.html\", \"/404.html\"]\n\n\ndef a_published_site(director: TestClient) -> None:\n    published_bite(director)\n    rid = published_report(director)\n    assert post_with_file(director, f\"/admin/reports/{rid}\", REPORT, pdf()).status_code == 303\n    published_report(director, slug=\"cds\", title=\"Common Data Set 2025-26\")\n\n\ndef stylesheets(html: str) -> list[str]:\n    return re.findall(r'<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"([^\"]+)\"', html)\n\n\n# Stylesheets and fonts\n\ndef test_the_app_serves_the_stylesheet_and_its_fonts(client):\n    css = client.get(\"/style.css\")\n    assert css.status_code == 200 and css.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"text/css\")\n    assert css.text == (settings.STATIC / \"site.css\").read_text()\n    assert FONTS, \"no fonts in static/fonts\"\n    for name in FONTS:\n        assert f'url(\"fonts/{name}\")' in css.text, name\n        font = client.get(f\"/fonts/{name}\")\n        assert font.status_code == 200 and font.headers[\"content-type\"] == \"font/woff2\", name\n        assert font.content == (settings.STATIC / \"fonts\" / name).read_bytes()\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", [\"/fonts/nope.woff2\", \"/fonts/..%2Fsite.css\", \"/fonts/\"])\ndef test_only_the_sites_own_fonts_are_served(client, path):\n    assert client.get(path).status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_publish_writes_the_stylesheet_fonts_and_licences_and_404(client_as, tmp_path):\n    a_published_site(client_as(\"admin\"))\n    site = exported(render_site(tmp_path / \"site\"))\n    assert site[\"style.css\"] == (settings.STATIC / \"site.css\").read_bytes()\n    for name in FONTS:\n        assert site[f\"fonts/{name}\"] == (settings.STATIC / \"fonts\" / name).read_bytes()\n    assert {\"fonts/OFL-atkinson-hyperlegible-next.txt\",\n            \"fonts/OFL-atkinson-hyperlegible-mono.txt\", \"404.html\"} <= set(site)\n\n\ndef test_public_site_css_is_gone_from_python():\n    assert not hasattr(public_site, \"CSS\")\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", PUBLIC_PAGES)\ndef test_a_public_page_links_only_the_sites_stylesheet(client_as, client, path):\n    a_published_site(client_as(\"admin\"))\n    page = client.get(path).text\n    root = \"../\" * path.removeprefix(\"/\").count(\"/\")\n    assert stylesheets(page) == [f\"{root}style.css\"] or path == \"/404.html\", stylesheets(page)\n    assert \"admin.css\" not in page\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", [\"/login\", \"/admin\", \"/admin/content\", \"/admin/users\",\n stylesheets(page) == [\"/admin.css\"]\n\n\ndef test_the_consoles_stylesheet_keeps_todays_look_and_the_sites_has_no_admin_rules(client):\n    admin = client.get(\"/admin.css\")\n    assert test_the_stylesheet_has_dark_mode_print_reduced_motion_and_a_focus_ring(client):\n    css = client.get(\"/style.css\").text\n    for needle in (\"@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)\", \"@media print\",\n                   \"@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)\", \":focus-visible\", \".skip-link\"):\n        assert needle in css, needle\n    # A Chart is capped at the width it is drawn for.\n    assert re.search(r\"\\.chart-figure \\{[^}]*max-width: 40rem\", css)\n\n\n# The layout\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", PUBLIC_PAGES)\ndef Admin pages only: the public\n    site links relatively (app.public_site).\"\"\"\n    return str(context[\"request\"].app.url_path_for(name, **path_params))\n\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\ntemplates.env.globals[\"path_for\"] = path_for\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"confirmation\"] = confirmation\ntemplates.env.globals[\"summary_max\"] = SUMMARY_MAX\ntemplates.env.filters[\"role_label\"] = ROLE_LABELS.get\ntemplates.env.filters[\"markdown\"] = render_markdown\n\"\"\"Every admin page is styled, and a refused request gets a page, not JSON.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import create_bite\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", [\"/login\", \"/admin\", \"/admin/content\", \"/admin/users\",\n                                  \"/admin/data-bites\", \"/admin/data-bites/{bid}\"])\ndef test_every_admin_page_links_a_stylesheet_that_loads(client_as, path):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = f\"http://testserver{path.format(bid=create_bite(director))}\"\n    page = director.get(url)\n    [href] = re.findall(r'<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"([^\"]+)\"', page.text)\n    css = director.get(urljoin(url, href))\n    assert css.status_code == 200 and css.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"text/css\"), href\n\n\ndef test_an_analyst_refused_a_director_page_sees_a_page(client_as):\n    response = client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/users\")\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"text/html\")\n    assert \"Directors only.\" in response.text\n    assert 'href=\"/admin\"' in response.text  # The user is\nre-loaded from the database on every protected request, so deactivating an\naccount ends its sessions at once.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, Request\n\nfrom app import users\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by current_user; main.py turns it into a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef current_user(request: Request) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    \"\"\"Dependency: the logged-in, still-active user, or LoginRequired.\"\"\"\n    user_id = request.session.get(\"user_id\")\n    user = users.get_active_user(user_id) if user_id is not None else None\n    if user is None:\n        request.session.clear()\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef require_director(user: sqlite3.Row = Depends(current_user)) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    \"\"\"Dependency: current_user, but 403 unless they are a Director.\"\"\"\n    if not users.is_director(user):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Directors only.\")\n    return user\n\n\ndef log_in(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n    # A fresh session (and CSRF token) on login, so a pre-login cookie planted\n    # by someone else never becomes an authenticated one.\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"user_id\"] = user[\"id\"]\n    csrf_token(request)\n\n\ndef log_out(request: Request) -> None:\n    request.session.clear()\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The session's CSRF token, created on first use. Templates call this.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if token is None:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf_token\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nasync def require_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every state-changing POST: the form's csrf_token must\n    match the session's.\"\"\"\n    form = await request.form()\n    submitted = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not (isinstance(submitted, str) and expected\n            and secrets.compare_digest(submitted, expected)):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Invalid or missing CSRF token.\")\n3:47-        {\"title\": \"Reports\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user,\n9:110-        {\"title\": \"Edit Report\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user,\n10:111-         \"report\": report, \"can_edit\": reports.can_edit(report, user),\n\"\"\"Shared test fixtures.\n\n`client` gives you the app. `client_as(role)` gives you a client that is logged\nin as a seeded user of that role — it works as soon as your login route exists,\nso access-control tests stay one line:\n\n    def test_editor_cannot_manage_users(client_as):\n        assert client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/users\").status_code in (302, 403)\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import db, settings, users\nfrom app.main import create_app\n\n# Matches scripts/seed_demo.py. Passwords come from the environment there; in\n# tests they are fixed and meaningless.\nDEMO_USERS = {\n    \"admin\": {\"email\": \"admin@example.test\", \"password\": \"[REDACTED]\"},\n    \"editor\": {\"email\": \"editor@example.test\", \"password\": \"[REDACTED]\"},\n}\n\n\ndef csrf_from(html: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Pull the CSRF token out of a rendered form.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(r'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"([^\"]+)\"', html)\n    assert match, \"no csrf_token field in the page\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef post_form(c: TestClient, path: str, data: dict, *, with_csrf=True):\n    \"\"\"POST an admin form as the logged-in client, with the session's CSRF token.\"\"\"\n    if with_csrf:\n        data = {**data, \"csrf_token\": csrf_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)}\n    return c.post(path, data=data, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef user_row(director: TestClient, email: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"This user's row of the Director's user list, as HTML.\"\"\"\n    for row in director.get(\"/admin/users\").text.split(\"<tr\")[1:]:\n        if email in row:\n            return row\n    raise AssertionError(f\"{email} is not listed\")\n\n\ndef user_id(director: TestClient, email: str) -> str:\n    return re.match(r' id=\"user-(\\d+)\"', user_row(director, email)).group(1)\n\n\ndef second_analyst(director: TestClient) -> TestClient:\n    \"\"\"A logged-in client for a second, named Analyst (not the seeded one).\"\"\"\n    account = {\"name\": \"Riley Intern\", \"email\": \"riley@example.test\",\n               \"password\": \"[REDACTED]\", \"role\": \"editor\"}\n    assert post_form(director, \"/admin/users\", account).status_code == 303\n    c = TestClient(create_app())\n    token = csrf_from(c.get(\"/login\").text)\n    c.post(\"/login\", data={**account, \"csrf_token\": token})\n    return c\n\n\ndef backdate(table: str, row_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Setup only: move a content row's timestamps into the past, so an edit\n    made within the same second still visibly changes updated_at.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {table} SET created_at = '2026-01-05 09:00:00',\"\n                     \" updated_at = '2026-01-05 09:00:00' WHERE id = ?\", (row_id,))\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef seeded_db(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    \"\"\"Every test gets its own database holding the DEMO_USERS, and its own\n    uploads directory. No deployed URL either, whatever a local .env says; a\n    test that needs one sets it.\"\"\"\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"DATABASE_PATH\", tmp_path / \"test.db\")\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"UPLOADS\", tmp_path / \"uploads\")\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"BASE_PATH\", \"\")","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"27337e07-ab98-4277-b3c6-6e6d64c7f2e1","timestamp":"2026-10-01T19:27:20.454Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"\"\"\"Sessions and CSRF.\n\nThe session is a signed cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, which signs with\nitsdangerous). {"parentUuid":"36741d4f-42c8-46e6-b27d-42b23e37f5e5","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfc4xXWwSmDthLvM3ytoS","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Gw49W1T6BcvKQMQwwzs1dz","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t21_console_shell.py","content":"\"\"\"T21: Console shell (issue #26, spec #25).\n\nEvery signed-in console page has the slim bar: the IR mark, numbered nav\n(Homepage and Users for a Director only) with the current section marked,\nwho is signed in, \"View site ↗\", and a Log out form with its CSRF token.\nThe console's own stylesheet carries the public site's fonts and tokens\nwithout linking the public stylesheet (ADR-007).\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_from\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import create_bite\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import create_report\n\nFONTS = sorted(path.name for path in (settings.STATIC / \"fonts\").glob(\"*.woff2\"))\n\nDIRECTOR_PAGES = [\"/admin\", \"/admin/content\", \"/admin/data-bites\", \"/admin/data-bites/{bid}\",\n                  \"/admin/data-bites/{bid}/delete\", \"/admin/reports\", \"/admin/reports/{rid}\",\n                  \"/admin/reports/{rid}/delete\", \"/admin/users\", \"/admin/homepage\"]\nANALYST_PAGES = [\"/admin\", \"/admin/content\", \"/admin/data-bites\", \"/admin/data-bites/{bid}\",\n                 \"/admin/reports\", \"/admin/reports/{rid}\",\n                 \"/admin/users\", \"/admin/homepage\"]  # the last two: \"Not allowed\" (403)\n\n\ndef page(c: TestClient, path: str) -> str:\n    bid, rid = create_bite(c), create_report(c)\n    return c.get(path.format(bid=bid, rid=rid)).text\n\n\ndef nav(html: str) -> str:\n    match = re.search(r'<nav class=\"nav-console\" aria-label=\"Console\">(.*?)</nav>', html, re.S)\n    assert match, \"no console nav\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef nav_links(html: str) -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(number, label, href) for each nav link, in order.\"\"\"\n    return re.findall(r'<a href=\"([^\"]+)\"[^>]*><span class=\"text-mono\">(\\d\\d)</span>([^<]+)</a>',\n                      nav(html)) and [\n        (number, label, href) for href, number, label in re.findall(\n            r'<a href=\"([^\"]+)\"[^>]*><span class=\"text-mono\">(\\d\\d)</span>([^<]+)</a>', nav(html))]\n\n\ndef current(html: str) -> list[str]:\n    return re.findall(r'aria-current=\"page\"><span class=\"text-mono\">\\d\\d</span>([^<]+)<', nav(html))\n\n\ndef logout_form(html: str) -> str:\n    match = re.search(r'<form method=\"post\" action=\"/logout\">(.*?)</form>', html, re.S)\n    assert match, \"no Log out form\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\n# The bar, on every signed-in page\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", DIRECTOR_PAGES)\ndef test_every_director_page_has_the_bar_nav_and_log_out(client_as, path):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    html = page(director, path)\n    assert nav_links(html) == [\n        (\"01\", \"Dashboard\", \"/admin\"), (\"02\", \"Data Bites\", \"/admin/data-bites\"),\n        (\"03\", \"Reports\", \"/admin/reports\"), (\"04\", \"Homepage\", \"/admin/homepage\"),\n        (\"05\", \"Users\", \"/admin/users\")]\n    form = logout_form(html)\n    assert f'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{csrf_from(html)}\"' in form\n    assert \">Log out</button>\" in form\n    assert '<span class=\"bar-console-mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">IR</span>' in html\n    assert \"<b>Console</b>\" in html\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", ANALYST_PAGES)\ndef test_an_analysts_nav_has_no_homepage_or_users(client_as, path):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    html = page(analyst, path)\n    assert [label for _, label, _ in nav_links(html)] == [\"Dashboard\", \"Data Bites\", \"Reports\"]\n    assert \"/admin/homepage\" not in nav(html) and \"/admin/users\" not in nav(html)\n    assert 'name=\"csrf_token\"' in logout_form(html)\n\n\ndef test_the_not_allowed_page_keeps_the_shell(client_as):\n    response = client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/users\")\n    assert response.status_code == 403 and \"Directors only.\" in response.text\n    assert current(response.text) == [] and logout_form(response.text)\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path, section\", [\n    (\"/admin\", \"Dashboard\"), (\"/admin/content\", \"Dashboard\"),\n    (\"/admin/data-bites\", \"Data Bites\"), (\"/admin/data-bites/{bid}\", \"Data Bites\"),\n    (\"/admin/data-bites/{bid}/delete\", \"Data Bites\"),\n    (\"/admin/reports\", \"Reports\"), (\"/admin/reports/{rid}\", \"Reports\"),\n    (\"/admin/homepage\", \"Homepage\"), (\"/admin/users\", \"Users\")])\ndef test_the_nav_marks_the_current_section(client_as, path, section):\n    assert current(page(client_as(\"admin\"), path)) == [section]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role, label\", [(\"admin\", \"Director\"), (\"editor\", \"Analyst\")])\ndef test_the_bar_shows_who_is_signed_in_and_the_public_site(client_as, role, label):\n    html = client_as(role).get(\"/admin\").text\n    assert re.search(rf'<span class=\"user-console-name\">{role} <span class=\"text-label\">'\n                     rf'{label}</span></span>', html), html\n    assert '<a class=\"user-console-site\" href=\"/\">View site ↗</a>' in html\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", DIRECTOR_PAGES + [\"/login\"])\ndef test_every_console_page_has_a_skip_link_to_its_main(client_as, path):\n    html = page(client_as(\"admin\"), path) if path != \"/login\" else \\\n        TestClient(client_as(\"admin\").app).get(\"/login\").text\n    assert '<a class=\"link-skip\" href=\"#main\">Skip to content</a>' in html\n    assert re.search(r'<main id=\"main\"[^>]*>', html)\n\n\ndef test_the_login_page_has_the_bar_but_no_nav_or_log_out(client):\n    html = client.get(\"/login\").text\n    assert '<span class=\"bar-console-mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">IR</span>' in html\n    assert \"nav-console\" not in html and 'action=\"/logout\"' not in html\n\n\ndef test_the_confirmation_keeps_its_fixed_text_in_its_new_look(client_as):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    create_bite(director)\n    html = director.get(\"/admin/data-bites\").text\n    assert '<p class=\"confirmation-console\" role=\"status\">' \\\n           \"Data Bite created as a Draft.</p>\" in html\n\n\n# The console's stylesheet\n\ndef test_the_consoles_stylesheet_has_the_sites_fonts_and_never_its_stylesheet(client):\n    css = client.get(\"/admin.css\").text\n    assert FONTS\n    for name in FONTS:\n        assert f'url(\"fonts/{name}\")' in css, name\n        # Relative to /admin.css, which is the public site's /fonts/ route.\n        font = client.get(urljoin(\"/admin.css\", f\"fonts/{name}\"))\n        assert font.status_code == 200 and font.headers[\"content-type\"] == \"font/woff2\"\n    assert \"@import\" not in css and \"site.css\" not in css and \"style.css\" not in css\n    for needle in (\"@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)\", \":focus-visible\", \".link-skip\",\n                   \"--color-field: #231443\", \"--color-citron: #d6f550\"):\n        assert needle in css, needle\n\n\ndef test_the_consoles_class_names_are_all_prefixed(client):\n    css = re.sub(r\"/\\*.*?\\*/\", \"\", client.get(\"/admin.css\").text, flags=re.S)\n    classes = set(re.findall(r\"\\.(-?[a-zA-Z_][\\w-]*)\", re.sub(r'url\\(\"[^\"]*\"\\)', \"\", css)))\n    assert classes and not [name for name in classes if \"-\" not in name.strip(\"-\")], classes\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", DIRECTOR_PAGES + [\"/login\"])\ndef test_no_console_page_links_the_public_stylesheet(client_as, path):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    html = page(director, path) if path != \"/login\" else TestClient(director.app).get(path).text\n    assert re.findall(r'<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"([^\"]+)\"', html) == tests.conftest import csrf_from\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import create_bite\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import create_report\n\nFONTS = sorted(path.name for path in (settings.STATIC / \"fonts\").glob(\"*.woff2\"))\n\nDIRECTOR_PAGES = [\"/admin\", \"/admin/content\", \"/admin/data-bites\", \"/admin/data-bites/{bid}\",\n                  \"/admin/data-bites/{bid}/delete\", \"/admin/reports\", \"/admin/reports/{rid}\",\n                  \"/admin/reports/{rid}/delete\", \"/admin/users\", \"/admin/homepage\"]\nANALYST_PAGES = [\"/admin\", \"/admin/content\", \"/admin/data-bites\", \"/admin/data-bites/{bid}\",\n                 \"/admin/reports\", \"/admin/reports/{rid}\",\n                 \"/admin/users\", \"/admin/homepage\"]  # the last two: \"Not allowed\" (403)\n\n\ndef page(c: TestClient, path: str) -> str:\n    bid, rid = create_bite(c), create_report(c)\n    return c.get(path.format(bid=bid, rid=rid)).text\n\n\ndef nav(html: str) -> str:\n    match = re.search(r'<nav class=\"nav-console\" aria-label=\"Console\">(.*?)</nav>', html, re.S)\n    assert match, \"no console nav\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef nav_links(html: str) -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(number, label, href) for each nav link, in order.\"\"\"\n    return re.findall(r'<a href=\"([^\"]+)\"[^>]*><span class=\"text-mono\">(\\d\\d)</span>([^<]+)</a>',\n                      nav(html)) and [\n        (number, label, href) for href, number, label in re.findall(\n            r'<a href=\"([^\"]+)\"[^>]*><span class=\"text-mono\">(\\d\\d)</span>([^<]+)</a>', nav(html))]\n\n\ndef current(html: str) -> list[str]:\n    return re.findall(r'aria-current=\"page\"><span class=\"text-mono\">\\d\\d</span>([^<]+)<', nav(html))\n\n\ndef logout_form(html: str) -> str:\n    match = re.search(r'<form method=\"post\" action=\"/logout\">(.*?)</form>', html, re.S)\n    assert match, \"no Log out form\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\n# The bar, on every signed-in page\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", DIRECTOR_PAGES)\ndef test_every_director_page_has_the_bar_nav_and_log_out(client_as, path):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    html = page(director, path)\n    assert nav_links(html) == [\n        (\"01\", \"Dashboard\", \"/admin\"), (\"02\", \"Data Bites\", \"/admin/data-bites\"),\n        (\"03\", \"Reports\", \"/admin/reports\"), (\"04\", \"Homepage\", \"/admin/homepage\"),\n        (\"05\", \"Users\", \"/admin/users\")]\n    form = logout_form(html)\n    assert f'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{csrf_from(html)}\"' in form\n    assert \">Log out</button>\" in form\n    assert '<span class=\"bar-console-mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">IR</span>' in html\n    assert \"<b>Console</b>\" in html\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", ANALYST_PAGES)\ndef test_an_analysts_nav_has_no_homepage_or_users(client_as, path):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    html = page(analyst, path)\n    assert [label for _, label, _ in nav_links(html)] == test_the_not_allowed_page_keeps_the_shell(client_as):\n    response = client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/users\")\n    assert response.status_code == 403 and \"Directors only.\" in response.text\n console page has the slim bar: the IR mark, numbered nav\n(Homepage and Users for a Director only) with the current section marked,\nwho is signed in, \"View site ↗\", and a Log out form with its CSRF token.\nThe console's own stylesheet carries the public site's fonts and tokens\nwithout linking the public stylesheet (ADR-007).\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_from\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import create_bite\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import create_report\n\nFONTS = sorted(path.name for path in (settings.STATIC / \"fonts\").glob(\"*.woff2\"))\n\nDIRECTOR_PAGES = [\"/admin\", \"/admin/content\", \"/admin/data-bites\", \"/admin/data-bites/{bid}\",\n                  \"/admin/data-bites/{bid}/delete\", \"/admin/reports\", \"/admin/reports/{rid}\",\n                  \"/admin/reports/{rid}/delete\", \"/admin/users\", \"/admin/homepage\"]\nANALYST_PAGES = [\"/admin\", \"/admin/content\", \"/admin/data-bites\", \"/admin/data-bites/{bid}\",\n                 \"/admin/reports\", \"/admin/reports/{rid}\",\n                 \"/admin/users\", \"/admin/homepage\"]  # the last two: \"Not allowed\" (403)\n\n\ndef page(c: TestClient, path: str) -> str:\n    bid, rid = create_bite(c), create_report(c)\n    return c.get(path.format(bid=bid, rid=rid)).text\n\n\ndef nav(html: str) -> str:\n    match = re.search(r'<nav class=\"nav-console\" aria-label=\"Console\">(.*?)</nav>', html, re.S)\n    assert match, \"no console nav\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef nav_links(html: str) -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(number, label, href) for each nav link, in order.\"\"\"\n    return re.findall(r'<a href=\"([^\"]+)\"[^>]*><span class=\"text-mono\">(\\d\\d)</span>([^<]+)</a>',\n                      nav(html)) and [\n        (number, label, href) for href, number, label in re.findall(\n            r'<a href=\"([^\"]+)\"[^>]*><span class=\"text-mono\">(\\d\\d)</span>([^<]+)</a>', nav(html))]\n\n\ndef current(html: str) -> list[str]:\n    return re.findall(r'aria-current=\"page\"><span class=\"text-mono\">\\d\\d</span>([^<]+)<', nav(html))\n\n\ndef logout_form(html: str) -> str:\n    match = re.search(r'<form method=\"post\" action=\"/logout\">(.*?)</form>', html, re.S)\n    assert match, \"no Log out form\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\n# The bar, on every signed-in page\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", DIRECTOR_PAGES)\ndef test_every_director_page_has_the_bar_nav_and_log_out(client_as, path):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    html = page(director, path)\n    assert nav_links(html) == [\n        (\"01\", \"Dashboard\", \"/admin\"), (\"02\", \"Data Bites\", \"/admin/data-bites\"),\n        (\"03\", \"Reports\", \"/admin/reports\"), (\"04\", \"Homepage\", \"/admin/homepage\"),\n        (\"05\", \"Users\", \"/admin/users\")]\n    form = logout_form(html)\n    assert f'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{csrf_from(html)}\"' in form\n    assert \">Log out</button>\" in form\n    assert '<span class=\"bar-console-mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">IR</span>' in html\n    assert \"<b>Console</b>\" in html\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", ANALYST_PAGES)\ndef test_an_analysts_nav_has_no_homepage_or_users(client_as, path):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    html = page(analyst, path)\n    assert [label for _, label, _ in nav_links(html)] == [\"Dashboard\", \"Data Bites\", \"Reports\"]\n    assert \"/admin/homepage\" not in nav(html) and \"/admin/users\" not in nav(html)\n    assert 'name=\"csrf_token\"' in logout_form(html)\n\n\ndef test_the_not_allowed_page_keeps_the_shell(client_as):\n    response = client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/users\")\n    assert response.status_code == 403 and \"Directors only.\" in response.text\n    assert current(response.text) == [] and logout_form(response.text)\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path, section\", [\n    (\"/admin\", \"Dashboard\"), (\"/admin/content\", \"Dashboard\"),\n    (\"/admin/data-bites\", \"Data Bites\"), (\"/admin/data-bites/{bid}\", \"Data Bites\"),\n    (\"/admin/data-bites/{bid}/delete\", \"Data Bites\"),\n    (\"/admin/reports\", \"Reports\"), (\"/admin/reports/{rid}\", \"Reports\"),\n    (\"/admin/homepage\", \"Homepage\"), (\"/admin/users\", \"Users\")])\ndef test_the_nav_marks_the_current_section(client_as, path, section):\n    assert current(page(client_as(\"admin\"), path)) == [section]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role, label\", [(\"admin\", \"Director\"), (\"editor\", \"Analyst\")])\ndef test_the_bar_shows_who_is_signed_in_and_the_public_site(client_as, role, label):\n    html = client_as(role).get(\"/admin\").text\n    assert re.search(rf'<span class=\"user-console-name\">{role} <span class=\"text-label\">'\n                     rf'{label}</span></span>', html), html\n    assert '<a class=\"user-console-site\" href=\"/\">View site ↗</a>' in html\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", DIRECTOR_PAGES + [\"/login\"])\ndef test_every_console_page_has_a_skip_link_to_its_main(client_as, path):\n    html = page(client_as(\"admin\"), path) if path != \"/login\" else \\\n        TestClient(client_as(\"admin\").app).get(\"/login\").text\n    assert '<a class=\"link-skip\" href=\"#main\">Skip to content</a>' in html\n    assert re.search(r'<main id=\"main\"[^>]*>', html)\n\n\ndef test_the_login_page_has_the_bar_but_no_nav_or_log_out(client):\n    html = client.get(\"/login\").text\n    assert '<span class=\"bar-console-mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">IR</span>' in html\n    assert \"nav-console\" not in html and 'action=\"/logout\"' not in html\n\n\ndef test_the_confirmation_keeps_its_fixed_text_in_its_new_look(client_as):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    create_bite(director)\n    html = director.get(\"/admin/data-bites\").text\n    assert '<p class=\"confirmation-console\" role=\"status\">' \\\n           \"Data Bite created as a Draft.</p>\" in html\n\n\n# The console's stylesheet\n\ndef test_the_consoles_stylesheet_has_the_sites_fonts_and_never_its_stylesheet(client):\n    css = client.get(\"/admin.css\").text\n    assert FONTS\n    for name in FONTS:\n        assert f'url(\"fonts/{name}\")' in css, name\n        # Relative to /admin.css, which is the public site's /fonts/ route.\n        font = client.get(urljoin(\"/admin.css\", f\"fonts/{name}\"))\n        assert font.status_code == 200 and font.headers[\"content-type\"] == \"font/woff2\"\n    assert \"@import\" not in css and \"site.css\" not in css and \"style.css\" not in css\n    for needle in needle\n\n\ndef test_the_consoles_class_names_are_all_prefixed(client):\n    css = re.sub(r\"/\\*.*?\\*/\", \"\", client.get(\"/admin.css\").text, flags=re.S)\n    classes = set(re.findall(r\"\\.(-?[a-zA-Z_][\\w-]*)\", re.sub(r'url\\(\"[^\"]*\"\\)', \"\", css)))\n    assert classes and not [name for name in classes if \"-\" not in name.strip(\"-\")], = [pytest.param(\"data-bites\", create_bite, bite_link, id=\"data-bite\"),\n                pytest.param(\"reports\", create_report, report_link, id=\"report\")]\n\n\ndef delete_page(c: TestClient, kind: str, item_id: str):\n    return c.get(f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/delete\")\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create, link\", DELETE_KINDS)\ndef test_deleting_lists_the_items_that_link_to_it_and_still_deletes(\n        director, client, kind, create, link):\n    target = create(director, slug=\"target\", title=\"The target\")\n    reference = link(target)\n    create_bite(director, slug=\"a\", title=\"Links from a Data Bite\", body=f\"[x]({reference})\")\n    create_report(director, slug=\"b\", title=\"Links from a Report\", body=f\"[y]({reference})\")\n    create_bite(director, slug=\"c\", title=\"Links elsewhere\", body=\"[z](https://example.test)\")\n\n    page = delete_page(director, kind, target)\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n    assert \"The target\" in page.text\n    assert \"Links from a Data Bite\" in page.text and \"Links from a Report\" in page.text\n    assert \"Links elsewhere\" not in page.text\n    assert f'action=\"/admin/{kind}/{target}/delete\"' in page.text\n\n    assert post_form(director, f\"/admin/{kind}/{target}/delete\", {}).status_code == 303\n    assert (data_bites if kind == \"data-bites\" else reports).get(int(target)) is None\n    assert {row[\"slug\"] for row in data_bites.list_all()} == {\"a\", \"c\"}\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create, link\", DELETE_KINDS)\ndef test_deleting_an_item_nothing_links_to_says_so(director, kind, create, link):\n    target = create(director, slug=\"target\")\n    page = delete_page(director, kind, target).text\n A Director publishes Reports and manages users; an Analyst drafts and publishes Data Bites.</p>\n  </div></div>\n  {% if error %}<p class=\"alert-console\" role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n\n  <section class=\"section-console\" aria-labelledby=\"accounts-title\">\n    <div class=\"head-section\"><span class=\"text-mono\">01</span><h2 id=\"accounts-title\">Accounts</h2></div>\n    <table class=\"table-items table-items-stack\">\n      <thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Email</th><th>Role</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead>\n      <tbody>\n      {% for u in users %}\n        <tr id=\"user-{{ u.id }}\">\n          <td class=\"table-items-name\">{{ u.name }}{% if u.id == user.id %} (you){% endif %}</td>\n          <td class=\"table-items-mono\">{{ u.email }}</td>\n          {# No controls on your own row (you can't demote or deactivate yourself)\n             or on a deactivated one. #}\n          {% if u.id == user.id or not u.is_active %}\n          <td>{{ u.role | role_label }}</td>\n          <td>{{ \"Active\" if u.is_active else \"Deactivated\" }}</td>\n          {% else %}\n          <td>\n            <form method=\"post\" action=\"/admin/users/{{ u.id }}/role\">\n              <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n              <select name=\"role\" aria-label=\"Role for {{ u.email }}\">\n                {% for value, label in role_labels.items() %}\n                  <option value=\"{{ value }}\"{% if value == u.role %} selected{% endif %}>{{ label }}</option>\n                {% endfor %}\n              </select>\n              <button type=\"submit\">Change role</button>\n            </form>\n          </td>\n          <td>\n            <form method=\"post\" action=\"/admin/users/{{ u.id }}/deactivate\">\n              <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n              Active\n              <button class=\"button-quiet button-danger\" type=\"submit\">Deactivate</button>\n            </form>\n          </td>\n          {% endif %}\n        </tr>\n      {% endfor %}\n      </tbody>\n    </table>\n  </section>\n\n  <section class=\"section-console\" aria-labelledby=\"add-title\">\n    <div class=\"head-section\"><span class=\"text-mono\">02</span><h2 id=\"add-title\">Add a user</h2></div>\n    <form method=\"post\" action=\"/admin/users\">\n      <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n      <p class=\"field-console\"><label for=\"user-name\">Name</label>\n        <input id=\"user-email\" name=\"email\" value=\"{{ form.email }}\" required></p>\n      <p class=\"field-console\"><label for=\"user-password\">Password</label>\n        <input type=\"password\" id=\"user-password\" name=\"password\" required minlength=\"{{ min_password_length }}\" autocomplete=\"new-password\" aria-describedby=\"user-password-hint\">\n        <small class=\"field-console-hint\" id=\"user-password-hint\">At least {{ min_password_length }} characters.</small></p>\n      <p class=\"field-console\"><label for=\"user-role\">Role</label>\n endif %}>{{ label }}</option>\n          {% endfor %}\n        </select></p>\n      <div class=\"actions-form\"><button class=\"button-primary\" type=\"submit\">Add user</button></div>\n    </form>\n  </section>\n{% endblock %}\nEOF\nuv run pytest tests/test_t02_users.py tests/conftest.py -q 2>&1 | tail -3","description":"Rewrite the Users page and run the user {"parentUuid":"5e11974d-0cbf-4ccc-a9af-af48cbaa9622","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfc5QLFFWDZ9hjnHFX6Np","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01FaV3kQc6dR7MnzXGsfPtcC","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"uv run python -m compileall -q app >/dev/null && echo compiled && git add static/admin.css templates app tests/test_t21_console_shell.py tests/test_t19_look_and_feel.py tests/test_success_messages.py && git status --short && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'\nT21: the console shell — the bar, numbered nav, Log out everywhere, and admin.css rewritten\n\nstatic/admin.css is the console's own stylesheet in the approved \"same\nfamily, calmer\" design: the public site's tokens and @font-face rules\ncopied (served at /admin.css, so fonts/ resolves to the public /fonts/\nroute), a dark mode, and prefixed class names only. The Editor and Chart\nbuilder rules are kept as they were for T23.\n\nbase.html is the console layout: a skip link, the slim bar with the IR\nmark, the numbered nav (Homepage and Users for a Director only, the\ncurrent section marked with aria-current), the user's name and role,\n\"View site ↗\", and a CSRF Log out form. The 403 page now looks up the\nsigned-in user so it keeps the shell. home_path is gone from every route.\n\nLogin, 403, confirm-delete, Users, and Homepage settings are restyled;\nthe dashboard keeps today's content, in a page head and hairline table.\n\nTests changed, with the reason:\n- test_t19: the console no longer avoids \"Atkinson\": spec #25 gives it\n  the site's fonts, copied into its own stylesheet.\n- test_success_messages: the Confirmation's class is now\n  confirmation-console (restyled); {"parentUuid":"494f3968-ed27-4a4c-84fe-54a303579953","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"7e0e7f6d-1446-442a-92dc-5dcfd10719a9","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01GjSAdpufQn3uZVT8YHJKot","type":"tool_result","content":"---\nname: browser-checks-environment\ndescription: \"What works for ticket browser checks here: viewport widths, phone width, real pastes, scratch instance\"\nmetadata:\n  node_type: memory\n  type: reference\n  originSessionId: 6d83085c-4859-4681-9c06-b59afa52f437\n  modified: 2026-10-01T19:12:26.566Z\n---\n\nBrowser checks for closing comments (spec #14) in this environment, as of 2026-10-01:\n\n- **768/1440 px and dark mode work through a same-origin iframe harness** (T19, 2026-10-01): serve the scratch `cms publish` export plus a harness page with `python -m http.server`, put iframes at 1440/768/390 px side by side scaled with `transform: scale()` (their `innerWidth` stays true, so media queries apply), and force dark by setting each `prefers-color-scheme: dark` CSSMediaRule's `media.mediaText = \"all\"` inside the frame. Print: same trick on `@media print`. Report `document.fonts` statuses and `scrollWidth > innerWidth` in the harness's status line.\n- **Screenshot `scale` also shrinks the saved file**: use scale 1 with `save_to_disk` for anything going in docs/screenshots.\n- **Programmatic `.focus()` in a frame doesn't match `:focus`** (no window focus); press real Tab keys on the page itself (the first Tab lands in browser chrome).\n- **Claude in Chrome's resize_window doesn't change the viewport** (stayed 516 px, or whatever the window is). 768/1440 px checks can't be done that way.\n- **gstack `browse` (headless) is killed by the command sandbox** (exit 137), and running it with the sandbox disabled was refused by the auto-mode classifier. Don't retry; ask the user.\n- **390 px for anything besides the public page** (e.g. a dialog): put a same-origin `<iframe src=\"/admin/...\">` 390 px wide on an admin page and drive it; its `innerWidth` is 390 and media queries apply. Keep it ≤740 px tall so the screenshot (scaled ~1.14×) shows it whole.\n- **Port 8001 may already be taken** by a leftover T15 scratch `cms serve` (its own scratch DB); check `lsof -ti :8001` and use another port rather than trusting it.\n- **Phone width works through the app itself**: the Site preview's **Phone** toggle frames the page at 390 px (388 inside).\n- **Real Excel/Sheets pastes need the user**: OS keystrokes via osascript stall on a permission prompt. The user pastes by hand; Claude reads the saved draft back.\n- **Scratch instance**: run `cms serve --port 8001` with `CMS_DATABASE`/`CMS_UPLOADS` in the session scratchpad and `scripts/seed_demo.py` passwords set by env, so checks never touch the real `cms.db`.\n- The user has accepted \"not checked\" for Safari and 768/1440 on T15 and T16, recorded on the issue.\n- **Click by element ref, not coordinates**: the screenshot coordinate frame switches between e.g. 1372×872 and 1200×763 within one session, so coordinate clicks miss (T18 typed a description into the body). Use `find` refs.\n- **Leaving a dirty Editor page** without the beforeunload dialog: add a submit listener that calls `preventDefault()`, then dispatch a synthetic `SubmitEvent` on the form. The Editor's own listener sets its \"leaving\" flag, and nothing is posted.\n- **Submitting forms** (T20, 2026-10-01): a ref click on a submit button, and `type` into a header search field, sometimes do nothing. `form_input` to set values plus `form.requestSubmit(button)` from `javascript_tool` works; check the Confirmation afterwards rather than trusting the click. Don't await across the submit's navigation in the same script (it errors \"Inspected target navigated\").\n- **Viewport harness file**: `render_site` wipes its output folder, so write the harness page into the export *after* publishing (T20 kept it at `<scratch>/t20/site/harness.html`, with `?page=&dark=1&h=`). Filter `document.fonts` to `Atkinson*`: the browser adds its own faces (Inter, Super Sans) to the list.\n- **A cached editor.js** can survive a server restart; `fetch(src, {cache: \"reload\"})` then navigate again.\n---\nname: design-taste\ndescription: \"User rejects default/\\\"AI-ey\\\" visual design; what was rejected and what was approved for the public site\"\nmetadata:\n  node_type: memory\n  type: feedback\n  originSessionId: eae09489-d0ef-4a1c-b220-1610b02a6314\n  modified: 2026-10-01T19:22:21.628Z\n---\n\nThe user rejected two mockups before approving one (session 22, 2026-10-01, spec #22):\n- Rejected as \"juvenile and AI-ey\": Inter, purple gradient hero, rounded cards with shadows and coloured top borders, pill nav, uppercase eyebrows everywhere.\n- Rejected as \"everyone uses this\": the newspaper look, meaning a Newsreader-style serif, italic standfirsts, and a masthead nameplate.\n- Approved, \"set like a dataset\": Atkinson Hyperlegible Next and Mono, solid Kenyon-purple fields with a faint plotting grid, one citron accent only on purple, numbered nav and sections, ISO dates, and Reports in a real table. The mockup is in `docs/design/session-22-mockup/`.\n\n- Admin console approved 2026-10-01 as \"same family, calmer\": public fonts and tokens on light paper, the purple field only as a slim top bar, square status badges, a pinned save bar. Mockup in `docs/design/admin-console-mockup/`. The user wants the console \"usable and pretty\", not just restyled: navigation, separate create pages, a dashboard of what needs attention.\n- Citron (neon green) is an accent for the purple field only; the user tried it in Charts (T19, 2026-10-01) and rejected it. Charts stay purples and greys.\n\n**Why:** they want it \"genuinely impressive and out of the box but also readable and a school website\".\n\n**How to apply:** for any visual work here (including the later admin-console redesign), don't start from stock patterns. Pick a concept tied to the office's actual subject and justify the font choice. Build on the approved system, not on defaults. {"parentUuid":"eff445d4-0ead-4112-bf1e-cadc597808e1","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"7e0e7f6d-1446-442a-92dc-5dcfd10719a9","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/davelleat/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.2.3/skills/engineering/code-review\n\nTwo-axis review of the diff between `HEAD` and a fixed point the user supplies:\n\n- **Standards**: does the code conform to this repo's documented coding standards?\n- **Spec**: does the code faithfully implement the originating issue / spec?\n\nBoth axes run as **parallel sub-agents** so they don't pollute each other's context, then this skill aggregates their findings.\n\nThe issue tracker should have been provided to you. If `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` is missing, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.\n\n## Process\n\n### 1. Pin the fixed point\n\nWhatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.\n\nCapture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.\n\nBefore going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.\n\n### 2. Identify the spec source\n\nLook for the originating spec, in this order:\n\n1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.\n2. A path the user passed as an argument.\n3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.\n4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report \"no spec available\".\n\n### 3. Identify the standards sources\n\nAnything in the repo that documents how code should be written, such as `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`.\n\nOn top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:\n\n- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.\n- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic (\"possible Feature Envy\"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.\n\nEach smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:\n\n- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.\n- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.\n- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.\n- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.\n- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.\n- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.\n- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.\n- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.\n- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.\n- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.\n- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.\n- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.\n\n### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel\n\n**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The full diff command and commit list.\n- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).\n- The brief: \"Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words.\"\n\n**Spec sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The diff command and commit list.\n- The path or fetched contents of the spec.\n- The brief: \"Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words.\"\n\nIf the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.\n\n### 5. Aggregate\n\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).\n\nEnd with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\n\n## Why two axes\n\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\n\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\n\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: since 260fe8b, T21 issue #26, spec #25"}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"6ff74193-f044-46ff-b238-a8d01c0a9c50","timestamp":"2026-10-01T19:38:08.527Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_01A5LLVkcuSns7jhmziALQMH","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"eb2665b0-6350-48dc-8f68-af34112cb437","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

The tokens and `@font-face` rules are copied from site.css, which ADR-007's two-stylesheet rule justifies. `clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem)` is repeated four times and could be a token.\n  - **Incomplete change:** `.admin-chart-builder [aria-invalid=\"true\"]` now uses `border-color: var(--color-danger)` but keeps `outline: 2px solid #b3261e`, so dark mode gets two different reds.\n  - **Speculative Generality:** `.facts-page`, `.actions-page` and `.text-hidden` are defined in admin.css but no console template uses them.\n  - **Repeated Switches:** `console_nav` filters with `is_director(user)`, while data_bites.html:22 and reports.html:10 and :19 still test `user.role == \"admin\"`. That is two idioms for one rule.\n  - **Primitive Obsession:** `CONSOLE_NAV` is a tuple of `(label, route, bool)` tuples, then rebuilt as dicts that carry an unused `director_only` key. A small NamedTuple would name the fields.\n  - **Divergent Change:** templating.py was a list of Jinja globals and now also holds nav and role policy (`console_nav`). It might belong in a routes or nav module.\n  - **Duplicated numbering:** section numbers `01`/`02` are hard-coded in each template, while nav numbers are computed. Any reorder means editing by hand.\n  - **Idiom:** base.html uses `path_for(...)` everywhere except `action=\"/logout\"`.\n</agent-message>"}

{"parentUuid":"3f54436e-ceb5-442c-b315-ddc72c4138d9","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"cc747b87-b80e-45de-aa8f-df30153df956","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_016o2tv2toZwkUoDhcLf2H8V","type":"tool_result","content":"## T20 closing: code review, resolutions, and browser check\n\nCommits:\n- `2035a69` Summaries and the Reports table\n- `989e6bf` Homepage settings\n- `e9088e3` the homepage and its featured Chart, plus the demo seed\n- `5886258` Site search\n- `29b20f9` glossary\n- `24e2b19` screenshots\n- `05d1f90` review fixes\n- the closing commit\n\nFull suite: **1360 passed** (1289 at the end of T19).\n\n### Code review (`/code-review` since `e540236`, two axes)\n\n#### Standards\n\nNo hard violations. All new links are relative, the new POST has CSRF, `/admin/homepage` is Director-only at the router, the index and the home page read only published items, and `search.js` writes only through `textContent`.\n\n| Finding | Kind | Resolution |\n|---|---|---|\n| `.latest-home p` is a broad selector that reached the Chart's own note and source paragraphs | Documented standard (CSS prefix rule, ADR-007) | **Fixed** in `05d1f90`: `.latest-home-summary` |\n| Context key `description` for the Summary: \"description\" is an _Avoid_ word in CONTEXT.md | Documented standard (vocabulary) | **Fixed**: `meta_description` |\n| `.button-read:hover` hard-codes `#4b2e84` | Judgement | **Fixed**: `--color-kenyon` token, which dark mode leaves alone |\n| Whitespace collapse written three times | Duplicated Code | **Fixed**: `content.one_line`, used by Summaries, Homepage settings, and the Site preview |\n| `.list-search` repeats `.list-data-bites` rule for rule | Duplicated Code | **Fixed**: shared selectors, with one-column overrides |\n| Visually-hidden recipe written twice | Duplicated Code | **Fixed**: one `.text-hidden` utility. The phone table's `thead` keeps its own copy inside the media query, with a comment |\n| `.admin-summary-field` and `.admin-homepage-field` rules identical | Duplicated Code | **Fixed**: one rule |\n| `item_base` hashed items without a Summary the old way | Speculative Generality | **Fixed**: always hashes all four fields. A form opened before the change is refused as stale once, on a local-only console |\n| `homepage` schema in `app/homepage.py`, with `db.py`'s docstring reworded | Divergent Change | **Fixed**: the schema is back in `db.SCHEMA`; `homepage.seed` only inserts the sample row |\n| `SettingsError` has the same shape as `ContentError`; the homepage route builds `error`/`error_field` inline | Duplicated Code | **Kept.** Homepage settings aren't content (CONTEXT.md), so they don't raise `ContentError`. The duplication is two lines |\n| `title, slug, body, summary` travel together through ~12 call sites | Data Clumps / Shotgun Surgery | **Kept.** A real refactor (an item-fields type) but out of T20's scope. Worth a ticket if another field arrives |\n| A search from inside a Site preview leaves the preview for `/search.html` | Note | **Kept.** It's the same as the preview's nav links (`site_file` sends any other page to the published one) |\n\n#### Spec\n\nNothing missing. Every acceptance criterion has code and a test. The differences from the spec's wording are recorded here:\n\n| Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|\n| The Confirmation reads \"Homepage saved. The public site updates at the next cms publish.\" The spec says \"Homepage saved.\" | **Kept, deliberately.** It is the same `SITE_NOTE` the publish and unpublish Confirmations carry, and the spec says settings appear \"on the next `cms publish`\". Still fixed text, as CONTEXT.md requires |\n| `og:title` is the item's title and `og:type` is `article`/`website`; the spec lists them as places \"a Summary shows\" | **Kept.** That's the only reading that makes sense for those tags: `og:description` and `meta description` carry the Summary |\n| The live count and the server can disagree on rare Unicode whitespace (JS `\\s` vs Python `str.split()`) | **Kept.** It differs by a character on unusual input, and the server's refusal is the rule |\n| Not asked for: the home page's description is its intro | **Kept.** The home page needs some description; the intro is the obvious one |\n| Not asked for: the demo seed now has Summaries, two Charts, and more items | **Kept.** The Director asked for sample data to see the whole design |\n| Not asked for: the headline is required, a Key figure needs both value and label, and line breaks in a Summary or setting become spaces | **Kept.** These keep the homepage from showing an empty `<h1>` or a number with no label |\n\n### Browser check\n\nScratch instance (`cms serve` on its own database in the session scratchpad), and its `cms publish` export served statically for the viewport harness (same-origin iframes, as in T19). Screenshots are in `docs/screenshots/`.\n\n| Check | Result | Screenshot |\n|---|---|---|\n| Edit the homepage (accent \"checked and final.\", figure 1,805 → 1,812), save, see it in a published copy | **Pass.** \"Homepage saved.\" shows. After `cms publish`, the exported `index.html` has both changes | `t20-homepage-settings-saved-1372.jpg`, `site-home-1440-768-390-light.jpg` |\n| Write a Summary and see its count and limit | **Pass.** It counts as typed, turns red at \"218 of 200: 18 too many.\", and the Site preview follows. Saving is refused beside the field (\"Keep the summary to 200 characters or fewer; it has 218.\") and the text is kept | `t20-summary-count-over-limit.jpg`, `t20-summary-refused-by-field.jpg` |\n| Search for a term in a title: \"enrollment\" | **Pass.** 2 results, the title match (Fall enrollment snapshot) above the Summary match (Factbook) | `t20-search-title-term-enrollment.jpg` |\n| Search for a term only in a Summary: \"census\" | **Pass.** 1 result | `t20-search-summary-only-census.jpg` |\n| Search for a term with no match: \"tuition\" | **Pass.** \"Nothing published matches “tuition”.\" | `t20-search-no-match-tuition.jpg` |\n| Home at 1440, 768, and 390 px, light | **Pass.** Atkinson Next and Mono `loaded` at every width (Next italic unused, so unloaded); no sideways scroll; figures four across, then two | `site-home-1440-768-390-light.jpg` |\n| Home at 1440, 768, and 390 px, dark | **Pass.** As above | `site-home-1440-768-390-dark.jpg` |\n| Without JavaScript | **Pass**, by test: `search.html` lists every published item, and no draft | — |\n\n`site-home-*` replaces T19's version, which left out the intro until this ticket.\n\n**Contrast of the new text** (WCAG ratio, light / dark):\n\n| Pair | Light | Dark |\n|---|---|---|\n| Accent and Key-figure notes (bright purple on the field) | 5.35 | 4.62 |\n| Summary under a title, intro (`--color-field-text` on the field) | 11.60 | 12.52 |\n| Muted text (Summaries in lists, the status line) on paper | 6.52 | 7.31 |\n| Search button (field on citron) | 13.60 | 14.69 |\n| Read the Data Bite button (white on the field) | 16.77 | 18.10 |\n| Its hover (white on Kenyon purple) | 10.38 | 10.38 |\n\n**Not checked:** Safari, and a share preview in a real Slack or email client. `og:url` and `og:image` are left out by design, so a preview shows the title and Summary only.","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"cf5b1684-0308-4a27-9bec-03033093bc71","timestamp":"2026-10-01T19:44:35.248Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"## T20 closing: code review, resolutions, and browser check\n\nCommits:\n- `2035a69` Summaries and the Reports table\n- `989e6bf` Homepage settings\n- `e9088e3` the homepage and its featured Chart, plus the demo seed\n- `5886258` Site search\n- `29b20f9` glossary\n- `24e2b19` screenshots\n- `05d1f90` review fixes\n- the closing commit\n\nFull suite: **1360 passed** (1289 at the end of T19).\n\n### Code review (`/code-review` since `e540236`, two axes)\n\n#### Standards\n\nNo hard violations.
