{"parentUuid":"50273f29-1f43-41b9-9f95-67753734d180","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfc6DQcVD2vV1kcG7U4T7","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Drafting the T21 closing comment in the same format while the suite finishes."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2938,"cache_read_input_tokens":212456,"output_tokens":3571,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":28},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2938,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":3571,"cache_read_input_tokens":212456,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2938,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2938},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"serverClassifierRequest":"d8e5bef1-837a-4c94-86af-9451cf606e4a","apiBlockIndex":1,"requestId":"req_011Cfc6DQAT6CV3kC5P7p6c5","type":"assistant","uuid":"83b9cea6-dd84-4e23-b0a8-b2bbfef1fba2","timestamp":"2026-10-01T19:44:36.878Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":"high","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"eb2665b0-6350-48dc-8f68-af34112cb437","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}
{"parentUuid":"83b9cea6-dd84-4e23-b0a8-b2bbfef1fba2","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfc6DQcVD2vV1kcG7U4T7","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01AiR9yBip2WLzoDH81UTHbC","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-davelleat-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/eb2665b0-6350-48dc-8f68-af34112cb437/scratchpad/t21-closing.md","content":"## T21 closing: code review, resolutions, and browser check\n\nCommits:\n- `63492c7` the console shell: the bar, numbered nav, Log out everywhere, and `admin.css` rewritten\n- `b3d46dd` the nav's scroll fade only on a phone\n- `cb6a849` review fixes\n- `ef3856d` screenshots\n- the closing commit\n\nFull suite: **FULL_SUITE**.\n\n### Code review (`/code-review` since `260fe8b`, two axes)\n\n#### Standards\n\nNo hard violations. Every POST keeps its CSRF token, including the new Log out in the bar. The console's root paths (`/admin.css`, `/logout`) are console-only, as before, and `site/` is untouched.\n\n| Finding | Kind | Resolution |\n|---|---|---|\n| ADR-007 still said `admin.css` was \"the old rules unchanged\", and nothing recorded that the console shares the site's fonts through the `/fonts/` route | Documented standard (ADR) | **Fixed** in `cb6a849`: ADR-007 has an \"Amended by spec #25\" section |\n| The dashboard's `<title>` said \"Admin\", which the glossary avoids; \"Console\" and \"Dashboard\" weren't in the glossary | Documented standard (vocabulary) | **Fixed**: the title is \"Dashboard\", and CONTEXT.md has **Console** (its home page is the Dashboard) |\n| The Chart builder's refused field: danger token for the border but `#b3261e` for the outline, so dark mode had two reds | Judgement | **Fixed**: both use `--color-danger` |\n| `.text-hidden`, `.facts-page`, `.actions-page` defined but unused | Speculative Generality | **Fixed**: removed until T24 needs them |\n| `clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem)` written four times | Duplicated Code | **Fixed**: a `--gutter-page` token |\n| `CONSOLE_NAV` as bare `(label, route, bool)` tuples, rebuilt as dicts with an unused key | Primitive Obsession | **Fixed**: a `NavItem` NamedTuple; the dicts carry only what the template reads |\n| `action=\"/logout\"` was the one hard-coded path in `base.html` | Idiom | **Fixed**: `path_for('logout')` |\n| Element selectors (`body`, `a`, `h1–h3`, and the form controls inside `<main>`) style the whole console | Documented standard (user CLAUDE.md, broad selectors) | **Kept, deliberately.** It's the console's own base, and ADR-007 means it can never reach the public site. The form controls are inside `:where(.page-console)`, so they weigh as much as an element selector and any class wins. Without them, the pages T22 and T23 haven't restyled yet would show browser-default controls |\n| Mixed prefixes: `.list-console` and `.page-console` beside `.head-page` and `.table-items`; `admin-*` survives | Judgement | **Kept.** These are the spec's and mockup's names (`.bar-console`, `.table-items`, `.bar-save`). All are prefixed, and a new test enforces that. The `admin-*` Editor rules go in T23 |\n| The visually-hidden recipe appears in media queries for the phone `thead` and the phone bar's name | Duplicated Code | **Kept.** Both apply only at a breakpoint, so a utility class can't stand in |\n| `console_nav` uses `is_director`, while the list templates still test `user.role == \"admin\"` | Repeated Switches | **Kept for T22**, which rewrites those templates |\n| `console_nav` in `templating.py` | Divergent Change | **Kept.** It's a template global beside `path_for`, and the only caller is `base.html` |\n| Section numbers `01`/`02` are written into each template | Judgement | **Kept.** The public site does the same: the numbers belong to each page's layout |\n\n#### Spec\n\n| Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|\n| **Between 40 and 56rem the bar's first row couldn't shrink.** With a long name such as \"Davelle Ampofo-Twumasi\", the page scrolled sideways at about 650 px. | **Fixed** in `cb6a849`. Measured with that name: one row needs about 1,324 px with the \"Institutional Research\" label, or 1,175 px without it. Now the label goes below 85rem, and the nav takes its own row below 76rem. Below 76rem a too-long name ends in an ellipsis. Re-checked at 390, 656, 768, 900, 1100, 1216, 1217, 1280, 1366, and 1440 px: no sideways page scroll, Log out on the first row at every width, and the whole nav visible from 656 px up. At 390 px the nav scrolls under its fade |\n| \"Every signed-in page shows the user's name and role.\" On a phone (≤40rem) the name and role are visually hidden but read by a screen reader | **Kept, deliberately.** At 390 px the bar's first row has room for the mark, \"Console\", \"View site ↗\", and Log out, and no more. The approved mockup hides them below 56rem; this hides them only below 40rem |\n| The Chart builder's outline colour | Fixed (see Standards) |\n| Not asked for: ledes on the login and Users pages, a password hint (\"At least 8 characters.\"), a \"What links to it\" section head on confirm-delete, and a \"403\" crumb | **Kept.** They come from the page-head pattern; behaviour is unchanged |\n| Not asked for: the dashboard's h1 is \"Dashboard\", and its Manage users, Homepage settings, and Log out links are gone | **Kept.** The nav and bar carry all three on every page now. The counts table is today's content, as the ticket says; T24 replaces it. `test_t00` now looks for `<h1>Dashboard</h1>` |\n| Not asked for: `base.html` lost the \"IPHS 400 Mini-Project #2\" footer and its unused `head`/`banner`/`nav` blocks | **Kept.** No template used the blocks, and the mockup has no footer |\n\nTests changed in place, with the reason: `test_t19` no longer requires \"no Atkinson\" in `admin.css` (spec #25 gives the console the site's fonts). `test_success_messages` matches the Confirmation's new class, and its text is unchanged. `test_t00` looks for the console home's new heading.\n\n### Browser check\n\nA scratch instance (`cms serve` on its own seeded database in the session scratchpad), signed in as the demo Director. The viewport harness is three same-origin iframes at 1440, 768, and 390 px on an admin page. Dark mode is forced by switching each frame's `prefers-color-scheme: dark` rules on. Screenshots are in `docs/screenshots/`.\n\n| Check | Result | Screenshot |\n|---|---|---|\n| Dashboard at 1440, 768, and 390 px, light | **Pass.** Atkinson Next and Mono `loaded` at every width (Next italic unused, so `unloaded`). Body font is \"Atkinson Next\", there's no sideways scroll, and Log out sits on the bar's first row. Nav: one row at 1440 px, its own row under the bar at 768, and scrolling sideways at 390 | `console-dashboard-1440-768-390-light.jpg` |\n| Dashboard, dark | **Pass.** As above | `console-dashboard-1440-768-390-dark.jpg` |\n| Users at 1440, 768, and 390 px, light | **Pass.** As above. The accounts table stacks into rows below 48rem, and \"05 Users\" is marked current | `console-users-1440-768-390-light.jpg` |\n| Users, dark | **Pass.** As above | `console-users-1440-768-390-dark.jpg` |\n| Homepage settings at 1440, 768, and 390 px, light | **Pass.** Key figures three across, then stacked | `console-homepage-1440-768-390-light.jpg` |\n| Login page | **Pass.** The bar with the mark only: no nav, no Log out | — |\n| Skip link and focus ring, with real Tab presses | **Pass.** The first Tab shows \"Skip to content\" (citron, top left). Further Tabs ring the nav links in citron on the bar | — |\n| Long name (a scratch user named \"Davelle Ampofo-Twumasi\"), 390–1440 px | **Pass** after the fix above | — |\n\n**Contrast** (WCAG ratio, light / dark). Every text pair is at least 4.5:1:\n\n| Pair | Light | Dark |\n|---|---|---|\n| Body text (ink on paper) | 17.57 | 15.79 |\n| Field text (ink on surface) | 18.27 | 14.98 |\n| Muted: ledes, hints, column heads (on paper) | 6.52 | 7.31 |\n| Muted on a hovered row (on tint) | 5.87 | 6.71 |\n| Links, section numbers (purple on paper) | 9.98 | 8.09 |\n| Confirmation (ink on tint) | 15.81 | 14.50 |\n| A refusal (ink on its tinted box) | 14.97 | 13.72 |\n| Deactivate, Delete (danger on surface) | 6.54 | 7.94 |\n| Field error (danger on paper) | 6.29 | 8.37 |\n| Primary button (white on Kenyon purple) | 10.38 | 10.38 |\n| Bar: nav labels, \"Console\", Log out (white on the field) | 16.77 | 18.10 |\n| Bar: nav numbers, role, \"View site ↗\" (field text on the field) | 11.60 | 12.52 |\n| IR mark, skip link (field on citron) | 13.60 | 14.69 |\n\nOne change from the mockup: the nav numbers and the bar's \"Institutional Research\" label use `--color-field-text`, not bright purple. Bright purple at that small mono size measured below 4.5:1 on the field.\n\n**Not checked:** Safari, and Windows High Contrast mode.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2938,"cache_read_input_tokens":212456,"output_tokens":3571,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":28},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2938,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":3571,"cache_read_input_tokens":212456,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2938,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2938},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01AiR9yBip2WLzoDH81UTHbC":{"file_path":"/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-davelleat-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/eb2665b0-6350-48dc-8f68-af34112cb437/scratchpad/t21-closing.md","content":"## T21 closing: code review, resolutions, and browser check\n\nCommits:\n- `63492c7` the console shell: the bar, numbered nav, Log out everywhere, and `admin.css` rewritten\n- `b3d46dd` the nav's scroll fade only on a phone\n- `cb6a849` review fixes\n- `ef3856d` screenshots\n- the closing commit\n\nFull suite: **FULL_SUITE**.\n\n### Code review (`/code-review` since `260fe8b`, two axes)\n\n#### Standards\n\nNo hard violations. Also test the bar with a **long user name** (set one in the scratch DB with sqlite3): T21's first breakpoint let \"Davelle Ampofo-Twumasi\" squeeze the nav at 900 px, which the short demo names hid.\n- **Measure a contrast claim before writing it**: T21's draft said bright purple failed on the field; it measured 5.35/4.62 and passed.\n- **A cached editor.js** can survive","originalFile":"---\nname: browser-checks-environment\ndescription: \"What works for ticket browser checks here: viewport widths, phone width, real pastes, scratch instance\"\nmetadata:\n  node_type: memory\n  type: reference\n  originSessionId: 6d83085c-4859-4681-9c06-b59afa52f437\n  modified: 2026-10-01T19:12:26.566Z\n---\n\nBrowser checks for closing comments (spec #14) in this environment, as of 2026-10-01:\n\n- **768/1440 px and dark mode work through a same-origin iframe harness** (T19, 2026-10-01): serve the scratch `cms publish` export plus a harness page with `python -m http.server`, put iframes at 1440/768/390 px side by side scaled with `transform: scale()` (their `innerWidth` stays true, so media queries apply), and force dark by setting each `prefers-color-scheme: dark` CSSMediaRule's `media.mediaText = \"all\"` inside the frame. Print: same trick on `@media print`. Report `document.fonts` statuses and `scrollWidth > innerWidth` in the harness's status line.\n- **Screenshot `scale` also shrinks the saved file**: use scale 1 with `save_to_disk` for anything going in docs/screenshots.\n- **Programmatic `.focus()` in a frame doesn't match `:focus`** (no window focus); press real Tab keys on the page itself (the first Tab lands in browser chrome).\n- **Claude in Chrome's resize_window doesn't change the viewport** (stayed 516 px, or whatever the window is). 768/1440 px checks can't be done that way.\n- **gstack `browse` (headless) is killed by the command sandbox** (exit 137), and running it with the sandbox disabled was refused by the auto-mode classifier. Don't retry; ask the user.\n- **390 px for anything besides the public page** (e.g. a dialog): put a same-origin `<iframe src=\"/admin/...\">` 390 px wide on an admin page and drive it; its `innerWidth` is 390 and media queries apply. Keep it ≤740 px tall so the screenshot (scaled ~1.14×) shows it whole.\n- **Port 8001 may already be taken** by a leftover T15 scratch `cms serve` (its own scratch DB); check `lsof -ti :8001` and use another port rather than trusting it.\n- **Phone width works through the app itself**: the Site preview's **Phone** toggle frames the page at 390 px (388 inside).\n- **Real Excel/Sheets pastes need the user**: OS keystrokes via osascript stall on a permission prompt. The user pastes by hand; Claude reads the saved draft back.\n- **Scratch instance**: run `cms serve --port 8001` with `CMS_DATABASE`/`CMS_UPLOADS` in the session scratchpad and `scripts/seed_demo.py` passwords set by env, so checks never touch the real `cms.db`.\n- The user has accepted \"not checked\" for Safari and 768/1440 on T15 and T16, recorded on the issue.\n- **Click by element ref, not coordinates**: the screenshot coordinate frame switches between e.g. 1372×872 and 1200×763 within one session, so coordinate clicks miss (T18 typed a description into the body). Use `find` refs.\n- **Leaving a dirty Editor page** without the beforeunload dialog: add a submit listener that calls `preventDefault()`, then dispatch a synthetic `SubmitEvent` on the form. The Editor's own listener sets its \"leaving\" flag, and nothing is posted.\n- **Submitting forms** (T20, 2026-10-01): a ref click on a submit button, and `type` into a header search field, sometimes do nothing. `form_input` to set values plus `form.requestSubmit(button)` from `javascript_tool` works; check the Confirmation afterwards rather than trusting the click. Don't await across the submit's navigation in the same script (it errors \"Inspected target navigated\").\n- **Viewport harness file**: `render_site` wipes its output folder, so write the harness page into the export *after* publishing (T20 kept it at `<scratch>/t20/site/harness.html`, with `?page=&dark=1&h=`). Filter `document.fonts` to `Atkinson*`: the browser adds its own faces (Inter, Super Sans) to the list.\n- **A cached editor.js** can survive a server restart; `fetch(src, {cache: \"reload\"})` then navigate again.\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":5,"oldLines":7,"newStart":5,"newLines":7,"lines":["   node_type: memory","   type: reference","   originSessionId: 6d83085c-4859-4681-9c06-b59afa52f437","-  modified: 2026-10-01T19:12:26.566Z","+  modified: 2026-10-01T19:47:27.707Z"," ---"," "," Browser checks for closing comments (spec #14) in this environment, as of 2026-10-01:"]},{"oldStart":25,"oldLines":4,"newStart":25,"newLines":6,"lines":[" - **Leaving a dirty Editor page** without the beforeunload dialog: add a submit listener that calls `preventDefault()`, then dispatch a synthetic `SubmitEvent` on the form. {"parentUuid":"51a9117f-4593-4394-828b-3ed2e5e6c580","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfc6S8H6WYNEe8fRojPGK","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"T21 (#26) is done: every signed-in console page now has the new bar, nav, and Log out, and the full suite passes (1416 tests). It's committed on `main` but not pushed, so #26 will close when you push.\n\n**What changed**\n- **`static/admin.css`** is rewritten from the approved mockup. It copies the public site's colours and fonts and never links `site.css`; the fonts load from the public site's existing `/fonts/` route. It has a dark mode, and a new test checks every class name is prefixed. The Editor and Chart builder styles are kept as they were for T23.\n- **`base.html`** is now the console layout:\n  - a skip link and the slim purple bar with the IR mark\n  - the numbered nav: 01–03 for everyone, 04 Homepage and 05 Users for the Director only, with the current section marked\n  - the user's name and role, \"View site ↗\", and a Log out form with its CSRF token\n  - an Analyst's \"Not allowed\" page keeps the bar.\n- **Restyled:** login, \"Not allowed\", confirm-delete, Users, and Homepage settings. Their behaviour is unchanged. The dashboard keeps today's counts table inside the new shell.\n- **Tests:** a new `tests/test_t21_console_shell.py` covers the ticket's list. I changed three existing tests in place, with the reason in each commit:\n  - the T19 test no longer requires the console to avoid the Atkinson fonts\n  - the Confirmation test looks for the new class name; the message text is unchanged\n  - `test_t00` now looks for `<h1>Dashboard</h1>`. That file says not to delete its tests; this one still checks that `/admin` answers, and only the heading it looks for changed.\n\n**Review and browser check**\n- The code review found one real bug: with a long name like \"Davelle Ampofo-Twumasi\", the bar overflowed at about 650 px and squeezed the nav to one item at 900 px. I fixed the breakpoints and rechecked from 390 to 1440 px: no sideways scroll, Log out always on the bar's first row, and the whole nav visible from 656 px up.\n- On a phone (390 px) the user's name and role are hidden on screen but still read by screen readers, because the bar only has room for the mark, \"View site ↗\", and Log out. The mockup hides them from 56rem down; this only does so on phones.\n- I briefly swapped the nav numbers off the mockup's bright purple on a contrast claim I hadn't measured. Measured, it passes (5.35:1 light, 4.62:1 dark), so I put it back and retook the screenshots.\n- Every text pair is at least 4.5:1 in both themes, and Atkinson Next and Mono load at every width.\n\nThe review findings and how each was handled, the browser check, and the contrast table are posted on #26: https://github.com/DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms/issues/26#issuecomment-5939261490\n\nCommit `8d0d7dd` (\"setup: warn at 30% context…\") landed in the middle of my commits but isn't mine; I left it alone.
